caption:
Momo is super bendy, but her squat gets stuck and her tailbone tucks the lower she goes.

Hip shape varies from person to person, so comfortable squat depth and stance width vary too. Rather than forcing depth, adjusting your stance width and toe angle to suit your hips can help.

Hybi's 1-minute routine: 90/90 knee switches × 8, knee-to-wall ankle rocks × 10 each side, then hold a comfortable-depth squat for 20–30 seconds. Stop if you feel a sharp pinch.
